description: This file contains the implementation of the ScreenPermissionDao class, responsible for data access related to screen permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It provides a method to retrieve permissions based on module name, action URL, and user roles.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling database operations related to screen permissions, extending the BaseDao class.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves screen permissions based on provided module name, action URL, and a list of roles (either role objects or role names).
